3-Month Momentum Leaders screener

Strongest 3-month price gainers.

Quick learning

How to trade this screen

What it means

Strongest 3-month price gainers — recent momentum, often pre-earnings or news-driven moves.

When to use it

Same playbook as Top-1Y: prefer pullback entries to a rising MA over chasing fresh highs. Check earnings calendar — don’t buy 1–2 days before reports.

How to act

BUY the controlled pullback (RSI 40–55, holding 21EMA). Target: prior breakout extension or next resistance.

Risks & caveats

Short-term momentum reverses quickly. Use tight trailing stops once 1R profit is achieved.

Educational guidance only — not investment advice. Always size positions to your own risk tolerance and use a stop-loss.
